80	### AD-06: One folder per run; TOML settings in, plain files out
81	**Status:** Accepted · **Date:** 2026-10-17 · **Scope:** `runs`
82	- **Context:** RUN-01 needs a run fully described by its settings. RUN-02 needs settings, seed, curve, checkpoint and games saved. RUN-05 needs reloading. The interrupted-run edge case needs partial records kept.
83	- **Decision:** Settings are read from TOML into a frozen `core.RunSettings`. Each run writes `runs/<name>-s<seed>-<timestamp>/` holding `settings.json` (the resolved settings), `curve.csv`, `checkpoint.pt` or `checkpoint.npz`, `games.npz` and `status` (`running`, `complete` or `incomplete`). The curve is appended as the run goes. An interrupt marks the run `incomplete`.
84	- **Alternatives:** An experiment tracker such as MLflow or W&B — a server or account for a one-person lab. One SQLite file — harder to inspect by eye and to delete one run from.
85	- **Consequences:** A run is inspectable with any text editor and deleted by removing its folder. Nothing indexes runs, so reports name their run folders explicitly.
